summary: Tested the client statement PDF (estratto conto) and payment reminders (solleciti) end to end. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed. I extracted the PDF text with pypdf and checked the Movimenti rows (Fattura shown as dare; linked NC '(storno fatt. X)', free NC and 'Incasso Bonifico ... - note' shown as avere; 'Compensazione NC' shown as an info row), the Partite aperte ('Scaduta da 45 gg', 'Scaduta da 15 gg', 'A scadere'), the totals (837 da incassare, 417 scaduto, -100 NC credits, 737 saldo; these figures are internally consistent), the IBAN and the 'Nessun movimento' case. Clients of other companies or unknown clients return 404. Preview: 'to' falls back to the PEC, subject format is correct and the html has the IBAN and the totals. Send: operatore gets 403; 400 for no email/PEC and for no overdue rates; 404 for another company; one real send to delivered@resend.dev returned 200 and the email service accepted it (202, PDF attached); the record is stored in db.solleciti and shows in the storico; 429 once 3 solleciti exist in 24h. Frontend (desktop + mobile): the estratto button downloads a %PDF; the sollecito button shows only for admin and only when the client has overdue amounts (hidden for client C with nothing overdue and for operatore); the dialog shows to/rate/scaduto/iframe preview and has the PDF button; send is disabled when there is no recipient (client B); after sending a success toast appears, the dialog closes and the storico shows on reopening. Iteration 9 regression: 19/19 pass. All test data was cleaned up (0 leftovers).

minor.issue: _party_ledger does not filter tipo='cliente', so a fornitore party id also returns a statement/preview. Low impact.
The 3-per-24h limit is a count followed by an insert with no lock, so two concurrent clicks could exceed it. Minor.

action_items: Optional: add pypdf to the dev/test requirements (the tests need it; I installed it in the venv only)
critical_code_review_comments: The /sollecito preview is open to operatore (read only). That looks intended, but note it exposes the email html to all tenant users.
Party email/PEC is only checked by regex at send time. The dialog shows a malformed address as a valid recipient, and sending then returns 400.
The PDF is built twice per send (once for the preview download, once for the attachment). Fine at the current scale.
seed_data_creation: TEST_T10 users, companies (random unique P.IVA per run), parties, invoices, payments and solleciti; all removed by clean_all() (regex on TEST_T10 / test-user-t10-). Verified 0 leftovers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && pytest test_iteration10_estratto_solleciti.py -n 0 (pip install pypdf first). Each run sends exactly 1 real email to delivered@resend.dev; the 429 test inserts fake solleciti records via mongosh instead of sending. UI seed: python seed_ui_t10.py prints TOK/OTOK/CID/A/B/C (cookie session_token, localStorage fe_company_id); python seed_ui_t10.py --clean. System date is 2026-10-30.
